analysis_metric_unavailable: Analysis is not available for this metric.
analysis_correlation_note: The server aligns samples by recorded time without extrapolating across gaps. Correlation does not imply causation.
stat_distribution_missing: There are not enough continuous samples to calculate a time distribution.
power_decoupling: Power / heart rate decoupling between halves
running_dynamics_note: Calculated by the server from valid cadence, ground contact time, vertical oscillation, step length, speed and power. Missing inputs are not replaced with zeros.
heart_zone_note: Zones use 50 / 60 / 70 / 80 / 90% of heart rate reserve. Z0 is below 50%; Z6 is at or above maximum heart rate. Readings above maximum heart rate are excluded from load.
splits_missing: Continuous, nondecreasing distance samples are required. Gaps and distance resets are not extrapolated.
splits_speed_change: Speed change in the second half
splits_note: Includes stopped time; the final split retains its actual distance. Halves cover equal distances and are separate from device-recorded laps.
laps_missing: The source did not record laps.
recorded_note: These are source records, not replacements for the analysis recalculated by the server.
analysis_profile_absent: No personal parameters were effective at the workout start.
zone_missing: Zones are unavailable without valid parameters or continuous samples.
history_initial_required: Explicitly select the training load before the start date.
history_initial_invalid: Enter valid initial CTL and ATL values.
heart_status_profile_missing: Add heart rate parameters in Settings with an effective date at or before the workout start.
heart_status_partial: Heart rate coverage is below 95%. The load below covers only the observed portion.
heart_status_excluded: This workout is excluded from statistics
heart_status_unavailable: Heart rate load cannot be calculated from the current data
settings_units_note: Metric · km / kg / W · Times use the browser's local time zone
settings_body_note: Each update adds a complete parameter record. Earlier workouts use the previous parameters; a past effective date changes analysis from that time onward. Workout-recorded weight and threshold take precedence.
settings_equipment_note: Manage bikes and running shoes. Catalog changes do not overwrite equipment already recorded in workouts.
settings_invalid_time: Enter a valid local effective time.
settings_invalid_values: Check the numeric values and required fields in settings.
settings_conflict: Settings changed in another session. Reload the latest settings before editing.
settings_discard_reload: Reloading will discard unsaved settings. Continue?
settings_heart_note: Enter your own parameters. Load uses the explicitly selected coefficient and does not infer it from your identity.
date_range_reversed: The end date must not be before the start date.
date_range_overflow: The end date is outside the supported range.
manual_invalid_start: Enter a valid local start time.
manual_invalid_minutes: Minutes must be a nonnegative integer.
manual_duration_overflow: Duration exceeds the supported time range.
settings_intro: Software preferences, personal parameters, equipment and account.
settings_demo: Settings require a real account. Demo mode is read-only.
page_history_title: Fitness and fatigue trends · AI Fitness
history_sign_in: Training history requires a real account.
history_initial_load: Training load before the start date
history_assume_zero: Explicitly assume no previous training load
history_completeness_note: Confirm only dates with complete records. A complete date with no workouts is rest; unconfirmed dates or insufficient heart rate coverage are unknown, as are subsequent CTL / ATL values. Power or pace load is not substituted.
history_confirm_all: Confirm complete records for all selected dates
workouts_intro: Record your rhythm and reflect on every effort.
workouts_order: Sorted by start time · Local time zone
filter_correct: Correct the filters to view workouts.
workouts_demo_empty: No workouts match these filters. Try another sport or select normal data in the demo scenarios.
workouts_empty: No workouts match these filters. Try another sport or add a workout manually.
account_local_time: Times are shown in your local time zone.
account_password_note: Changing your password signs out all devices. Sign in again with the new password.
account_confirm_all: Sign out all devices, including this page?
account_confirm_current: Sign out this device and return to sign-in?
account_confirm_device: Sign out this device? It will need to sign in again.
account_device_revoked: That device has been signed out.
account_password_required: Enter your current and new passwords.
account_password_mismatch: The new passwords do not match.
metric_calculated_note: Calculated statistics include recorded zeros. Gaps longer than two minutes are excluded from the time-weighted average.
metric_recorded_note: Showing the summary included in the record. Charts retain original samples; missing records are not filled with zeros.
metric_summary_missing: No summary statistics are available for this metric. Recorded samples are shown below.
metric_pace_note: Pace is converted from the corresponding speed. Average pace corresponds to average speed; fastest sample pace is not the best sustained kilometre pace. Zero speed has no finite pace.
metric_distance_note: Distance is aligned by recorded time and interpolated only between adjacent distance records, never across gaps or distance resets. Metric values remain original samples.
metric_distance_missing: No distance samples can be aligned. Switch to time to view the original chart.
metric_summary_only_title: This workout contains only summary data
metric_summary_only: There are no individual samples to chart. Summary values are marked as calculated or recorded according to their source.
power_curve_missing: There are not enough continuous power samples to calculate best sustained power.
running_cadence_note: Running cadence counts total steps from both feet (steps/min).
metric_provenance_note: Calculated statistics come from the server's analysis of the current revision's samples. Recorded statistics come directly from the workout record. Charts retain original timestamps and zeros; gaps and zoom do not change statistics.
metric_heart_note: Heart rate zones use personal parameters effective at the workout start. Post-workout recovery readings are outside the current model.
power_curve_intro: Highest average power for each duration · Single workout · W
power_curve_stale: The workout has changed. Refresh to view its current power curve.
route_synthetic_description: Synthetic route diagram, without a basemap
route_choose_time: Select a time point on the route
workout_edit_note: Edit the title, notes and tags. Workout time, distance and measurements stay the same.
workout_edit_conflict: Your draft has been kept. Load the latest version, then edit and save again.
workout_delete_note: Deletion cannot be undone. Reimporting the same file or Apple Health workout will not automatically restore it.
workout_confirm_reload: Reloading will discard your changes and use the latest server version. Continue?
route_synced: Marker follows the selected chart time
route_point_missing: No position recorded at this time
chart_interaction_hint: Hover to inspect · Click to enlarge · Esc to unpin
metric_recorded_only: Recorded summary only · No sample chart
metric_missing_samples: This workout has no individual samples to calculate metric averages or maximums.
chart_gap_note: Horizontal axis: elapsed time (h:mm:ss). Missing samples remain gaps and are not filled with zeros.
route_select_sample: Select a sample on the route
import_intro: Import a cycling or running workout exported from a sports device.
import_demo: Uploading requires a real account. Demo mode is read-only.
import_privacy_note: The original file is stored privately for reprocessing. Uploading the same file again on this account returns the existing record.
import_uncertain: The result is not confirmed. Retry with the same file so the server can check for an existing record.
import_success_note: Saving is confirmed. Uploading the same file again returns the existing workout.
import_removed_title: The workout from this file was removed
import_removed_note: Uploading it again will not restore a deleted workout.
import_pending_note: Check the result later to confirm whether the workout was saved.
import_empty_file: This file is empty. Choose another file.
import_file_too_large: This file exceeds the size limit. Choose another file.
import_unsupported: Only FIT activity files containing a single cycling or running workout are currently supported.
import_missing_time: The file has no valid workout time and cannot be imported.
import_limit_exceeded: The file exceeds the parsing limit.
import_invalid_file: The file is damaged or is not a valid FIT activity. Export it again and retry.
import_invalid_data: The file failed parsing or validation. Check its source and export it again.
manual_intro: Enter the time and distance of your cycling or running workout.
manual_demo: Adding a workout requires a real account. Demo mode is read-only.
manual_uncertain: Saving is not confirmed. Retrying checks the same submission. Before refreshing or leaving, check the list for an existing record.
manual_check_values: Check the time, duration and distance.
workout_edit_demo: Editing and deletion require a real account. Demo mode is read-only.
route_help: The start is an open circle and the selected position is a dark dot. Selection uses actual recorded timestamps.
route_missing: This workout has no recorded GPS route.
metric_empty_note: Return to workout details to explore other recorded metrics.
analysis_correlation_summary: Sample correlation {correlation} · Aligned samples: {count} · Chart limited to 600 points
power_analysis_note: Power connects adjacent samples only within 5 seconds. Normalized power requires complete 30-second rolling windows; normalized duration: {duration}. Training stress, efficiency and decoupling require full coverage. Interpret short or nonsteady workouts cautiously.
heart_timing_basis: Timing basis: {basis} · Active time {active} · Covered time {covered}
analysis_sampling_note: Sensor statistics and distributions are time-weighted with a maximum connecting gap of {seconds} seconds. Zeros are retained; gaps are neither extrapolated nor filled. Missing results show no data.
import_maximum: One file at a time, up to {size} MiB.
history_submitted: Submitted dates: {start} — {end} · Initial state: {initial}. Recalculate after changing inputs.
history_method_note: Algorithm {method} · Parameter revision {revision} · The server calculates all load and decay; these are not health-risk assessments.
account_password_length: The new password must contain {minimum}–{maximum} characters.
workout_confirm_delete: Delete “{title}”? This cannot be undone and your current edits will be discarded.
power_curve_method: Uses elapsed time, including recorded zeros. Samples up to {seconds} seconds apart are linearly interpolated; longer gaps break the interval without zero filling or endpoint extrapolation. Duration uses a logarithmic axis; connecting lines are reading guides. Best-interval times are relative to workout start.
metric_axis_note: Horizontal axis: {axis} · Gaps longer than two minutes break the line
metric_source_note: Data source: {source} · Times use the local time zone
demo_intro: Explore the same workout from the list to charts, on desktop and mobile.
demo_features: Browse cycling and running workouts, filter by sport, open details, select metric samples and inspect synthetic routes. Use the scenario picker to try slow, empty and failed responses.
demo_privacy: All workouts and routes are synthetic. This demo does not read or save your health records. Routes are diagrams without a basemap and do not request third-party maps.
demo_scope: This read-only demo does not sign in, upload FIT files or edit records. Connected mode supports those workflows with your own server. Demo statistics come from synthetic responses; the browser does not calculate training load or health scores.
settings_discard_equipment: Discard unsaved changes to this equipment?
